福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・安平區

盧經堂厝Lu Jing-tang House

安平有句老話：「有躼旗富，無躼旗厝。」台語的「躼」是高的意思。他就是身材高大的安平首富盧經堂。安平開港通商後，他代理英商煤油公司，進口蠟燭與煤油。日治時期，他擔任三井洋行的米穀、砂糖買辦。1902 年，他在善化創辦製糖會社，生產黑糖外銷南洋與廈門。據說他是安平第一位穿西裝的士紳。大宅約 1898 年落成，原為三落大厝，有「三落百二門」的氣派。建築融合閩南合院與南洋裝飾，一腳踩在舊時代，一腳跨進新世界。門樓前抬頭找兩方泥塑匾額：「屏山帶水」與「座對薰風」。

Old Anping had a saying: You may be as rich as Lò-kî, but you'll never own a house like Lò-kî's. Lò-kî means the tall one in Taiwanese. He was Lu Jing-tang, the wealthiest man in Anping a century ago. After Anping opened to foreign trade, he became the agent for a British kerosene company, importing candles and lamp oil. Under Japanese rule, he was a comprador for Mitsui and Company in rice and sugar. In 1902, he founded a sugar company in Shanhua that exported brown sugar to Southeast Asia and Xiamen. He is said to be the first gentleman in Anping to wear a Western suit. His mansion, completed around 1898, had three halls. Locals said it had a hundred and twenty doors. It blends a Minnan courtyard house with Southeast Asian decorative touches, one foot in the old world and one in the new. At the gate, look up for two plaques: Screened by hills, girdled by water, and Facing the fragrant breeze.

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

盧經堂厝是安平首富盧經堂的大宅。他身材高大，安平人叫他「躼旗」；從代理英商煤油到擔任三井洋行的買辦，他的一生正好走過安平開港到日治的貿易時代。宅子融合閩南合院與南洋裝飾，至今是市定古蹟。

This was the home of Lu Jing-tang, the richest man in old Anping, nicknamed the Tall Man. His career ran from selling British kerosene to buying rice and sugar for a Japanese trading house, and his house mixes a southern Fujian courtyard home with Southeast Asian decoration.

  1. 開港後 After the port opened盧經堂代理英商煤油公司，進口蠟燭與煤油。Lu becomes the agent for a British kerosene company.
  2. 約 1898 Around 1898大宅落成，原為三落大厝。The house is finished, three halls deep.
  3. 1902他在善化創辦製糖會社，黑糖外銷南洋與廈門。He starts a sugar company in Shanhua, selling brown sugar to Southeast Asia and Xiamen.
  4. 今天 Today市定古蹟，可以換古裝拍照，也能預約古禮「抓周」。A city monument where visitors can dress in old-style clothes or book a traditional first-birthday ceremony.

認識景點

About the place

大厝、大宅：非常大、氣派的房子。盧家大厝有三落。 買辦：替外國公司做生意的本地代理人。 煤油：點燈用的油。盧經堂替英商進口煤油。 蠟燭：還沒有電燈時，人們用蠟燭和煤油照明。

mansion: A very large and grand house. Lu's mansion had three halls. comprador: A local agent who does business for a foreign company. kerosene: Oil for lamps. Lu imported it for a British company. candle: Before electric lights, people used candles and lamp oil.

黑糖：他的製糖會社把黑糖外銷南洋與廈門。 西裝：據說他是安平第一位穿西裝的士紳。 通商口岸（開港）：開放外國通商的港口。安平開港後，商人致富。 商號（豐源）：做買賣的公司。盧經堂開了自己的商號「豐源」。

brown sugar: His sugar company sent brown sugar to Southeast Asia and Xiamen. Western suit: He was said to be the first gentleman in Anping to wear one. treaty port: A port opened to foreign trade. Anping became one, and merchants grew rich. trading firm: A company that buys and sells goods. Lu ran his own firm, Feng-yuan.

合院：圍著中庭蓋的房子，是閩南傳統。 南洋裝飾：融入閩南大厝的南洋風裝飾。 匾額：掛在門上的題字。「范陽」是盧姓的郡號。 古裝：古代風格的衣服。可以在這裡換古裝拍照。

courtyard house: A house built around an open yard, a Minnan tradition. Southeast Asian decoration: Decorative touches from Southeast Asia, mixed into the old Minnan house. plaque: A board with words over a door. Fanyang is the Lu clan's ancestral seat. period costume: Old-style clothes. You can dress up in them for photos here.

抓周：週歲的古禮：寶寶從面前的東西裡抓一樣。

grabbing ceremony: A first-birthday custom: the baby grabs one of the objects in front of it.

實景照片

Photos on site

門樓與匾額 The gate and its plaque

盧經堂厝的門樓。門上方的匾額寫著「屏山帶水」（由右往左讀），講的是宅子的座向與風水；左邊的木牌標示這裡是市定古蹟。

This is the gate of the Lu Jing-tang House. The plaque above the door reads: Screened by hills, girdled by water. The wooden sign says it is a city-listed historic site.

紅磚大厝 The red-brick hall

穿過門樓，就看到紅磚大厝。紅磚牆砌出一格格幾何花紋，門框是石材做的，右邊還有一扇上下緣呈波浪形的窗。這座古厝推估約 1898 年興建。

Through the gate stands the red-brick house. Its bricks form geometric patterns, the door has a stone frame, and one window has wavy edges. The house was built around 1898.
